sections.heading: ANALYSIS
bullets: Token Bucket algorithm: tokens are added to the bucket at a fixed refill rate; requests consume tokens; if bucket is empty, requests are rejected with HTTP 429
Bucket Capacity: the maximum number of tokens the bucket can hold; determines the maximum request rate allowed
Refill Rate: the rate at which tokens are added to the bucket per unit time; controls how quickly the bucket recovers

Redis requirement: when multiple application instances are used, Redis provides centralized rate-limit storage so all instances share the same rate state; without Redis each instance would have its own independent bucket
